sheet_from: Data/World39/Tile*.OZJ, from MuMain, decoded under a kl_ prefix (the Ruins are kr_, the Tower kt_): assets/textures is one flat pool. The ten slots the grid draws; TileWater01 ships but no tile wears it. docs/worlds/kanturu-port.md Part B 8.1.
slot_note: No grass .OZT ships, so no grass grows. TileGrass01, the grey-brown octagon paving, is 87.5% of the drawn ground; TileRock04 10.5%.
material_note: Read off the art; the names lie. TileGrass01 and TileRock04 octagon paving, TileGrass02 the paving with its carved emblem, TileRock03 a carved stone disc: flagstone. TileGround03 and TileRock01, one 128 riveted iron plate in two stripes: flagstone, as there is no metal material. TileGround02 rough grey ground and TileRock02 red-veined cracked stone: rock. TileGround01 olive moss and TileWood01 brown earth: sand.
